args.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this complete square Mars lander scene. The requested repair MUST be designed in the whole scene as an integral load-bearing support, not pasted in as a separate isolated object. Preserve the exact 780x780 composition, camera, cabin, ladder, all existing legs/feet and their positions, vehicle height, colour, sun/shadows and landscape. Change ONLY the dark short added support under the front lower frame, just right of the ladder. The existing shape is a decorative cylindrical pedestal under a poorly fitting open U cup; replace it with a plain minimal hand-fabricated dark matte iron support at a CLEAR STRONG CHASSIS JUNCTION where the lower front frame tube meets the diagonal frame brace, immediately right of the ladder. Visibly support that structural junction, NOT a thin hydraulic piston rod or a dangling skin panel. A short sturdy straight square-section iron strut rises from a broad plain rectangular plate lying flat on firm soil. Its top is a broad formed saddle that closely follows and hugs the underside/lower sides of the existing structural tube/junction, with continuous visible contact and no air gap or oversized open empty cup. Make the saddle aligned with the actual angle and width of that tube; show enough of the structural junction above it that the load path to the body is understandable. A small simple welded gusset beneath the saddle is enough if structurally useful. No elaborate jack, circular ornamental base, threaded adjuster, brass, dials, extra bolts or tall framework. The support is comparably substantial to the original legs but not bulkier. No temporary bricks, blocks, rock catch, ground bolts or new machinery. Keep all unaffected pixels as close to the original as possible; do not move or redesign original chassis members merely to accommodate the repair. Return the complete square scene with the installed support and its contacts clearly resolved in context.
